title: Request for email communications of certain village board members

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Wisconsin Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Electronic copies of the following public records for the period of May 1, 2026, through September 24, 2026:

1. Email Communications

Copies of all emails sent or received by Village Board members Donald Kern, Jessica Plourde, or Chris Dubek during the period identified above that relate to, concern, discuss, reference, or arise from the business, affairs, governance, operations, activities, policies, finances, personnel, services, property, proceedings, or functions of the Village of Somerset.

This request includes responsive emails:

sent or received through a Village of Somerset email account;
sent or received through a personal, private, business, or other non-Village email account when the communication relates to Village of Somerset business;
exchanged between or among any of the four Board members identified above;
exchanged between any identified Board member and any other Village Board member;
exchanged between an identified Board member and Village employees, officers, officials, committee or commission members, consultants, contractors, vendors, attorneys, or members of the public; and
on which an identified Board member was the sender, recipient, copied recipient (cc), or blind-copied recipient (bcc), to the extent a responsive record exists.

For purposes of this request, “Village of Somerset business” should be construed broadly to include any matter involving the Village of Somerset or the performance, discussion, consideration, or exercise of the duties or responsibilities of a Village Board member. 

2. Scope of Search

This request is intended to encompass responsive public records based upon their content and relationship to Village business, rather than solely upon the ownership of the device, account, or system on which the record is located.

Accordingly, please include responsive records concerning Village business maintained through personal accounts or devices to the extent such records constitute public records subject to Wisconsin's Public Records Law.

3. Withheld Records

If any responsive record is withheld in whole or in part, or any information is redacted, please identify the record or category of records withheld or redacted and provide the statutory or other legal authority supporting the withholding or redaction.

If the Village determines that any portion of this request is insufficiently specific under Wis. Stat. § 19.35(1)(h), please identify the particular portion considered insufficiently specific and the basis for that determination so that the scope may be clarified without delaying production of records responsive to the remainder of the request.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

John Brannon

title: Field Tested Livestream Competition Documents (United States Department of the Army)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Records relating to "Field Tested," the U.S. Army livestreamed reality competition broadcast on Twitch on or around September 16–18, 2026, part of the Field Tested campaign announced August 31, 2026.
  - Contracts, task orders, statements of work, and modifications covering the Twitch/livestream competition, including those with TBWA/Chicago or any subcontractor, production company, or talent agency.
  - Invoices, budgets, and cost breakdowns showing payments or fees for streamer/talent participation.
  - Talent or participation agreements with the streamers who appeared in the event.
  - Briefing materials, run-of-show documents, scripts, talking points, and content guidelines given to participants, including any restrictions on what they could say on stream.
  - Instructions or guidelines for managing Twitch chat during the event, including moderation policies, banned-word or blocked-term lists, and guidance on responding to criticism.
  - Reports or metrics on the event's performance, such as viewership and recruitment leads.

This request includes records created by Army personnel as well as records created by contractors or subcontractors, including TBWA/Chicago, production companies, and talent agencies, that are in the Army's possession or control.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Eugene Butler
